title: LED Christmas lights still annoy me. Let's try some more fixes.
summary: Technology Connections complains about the harsh, overly blue color of modern LED Christmas lights and tries more fixes for them. It follows earlier videos by the same creator on holiday lighting.
why: HN cites it whenever LED holiday lights look wrong or give people headaches, as an explanation of why they seem too blue.

quote.text: Technology Connections made a video about this recently.
